content:
maya: Quick sync — we need a final, scoped GA acceptance plan for the Scope Slicer initiative. Focus: SLA tiers, docs owners, burn-in/canary, monitoring thresholds, and pricing recommendations. Deadline: EOD Friday.

sam: Quick ask — can we preserve current infra assumptions? If not SLA numbers will change cost.

leo: If we keep current infra, target p95 latency is ~160ms on baseline load. Anything stricter needs extra GPU pools.

maya: Constraints: Legal flagged any customer contract >$100k must have 99.9% SLA. That locks Enterprise. We can be more flexible for self-serve.

olivia: I can own public docs (Quickstart + Runbook). Need someone from eng to give step-by-step smoke tests + sample payloads.

eng-oncall: Will drop a smoke test and a minimal repro script in #eng-oncall by tomorrow. Example snippet I'll include: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"scope-slicer-v1","input":"ping"}'
```

sam: Burn-in proposal: 72h continuous traffic with staged ramp (0→10→30→50 rps). Ops needs a ticket + owner for canary/observability.

nina: I can own the canary run (setup + metrics). Creating ticket RH-5021 now, assigning to myself. Target start: Friday 09:00 PT.

maya: Monitoring: define 3 signals for automated fallback — p95 latency, error-rate, and token-queue depth. Fallback policy: if p95 > 200ms for 10m OR error-rate > 1% for 5m -> route to quantized smaller model.

leo: Add: if token-queue depth > 1000 for 5m, trigger autoscale + paging to Eng SRE. We'll need alert runbooks.

olivia: Docs checklist — Quickstart, Runbook, SLO table, Pricing FAQ, Known Limitations. I'll draft pricing FAQ but need finops numbers.

sam: Pricing options: (A) usage-based with soft cap & overage; (B) subscription reserved capacity. My recommendation: Default to usage-based for self-serve, provide reserved commit for enterprise.

olivia: Agreed. For GA public docs we should show example tiers and a simple calculator snippet. I'll draft numbers but need finance signoff.

eng-oncall: For rollback/runbook: automatic fallback to smaller model is ok; manual rollback steps: 1) disable new rollout; 2) point traffic to previous model tag; 3) revoke canary pool. I'll author the steps.

maya: Owners summary (confirm if correct): SLA decision & legal consult — sam; Docs (quickstart/runbook/pricing FAQ) — olivia; Burn-in/canary — nina + eng-oncall; Monitoring & alerts — leo + eng-sre; Pricing spec — olivia + finops; Rollback playbook — leo + eng-oncall. Reply to confirm.

sam: Confirmed. I'll loop in legal for the >$100k rule and surface any exceptions.

nina: Confirmed. I'll post canary run checklist (health checks, traffic profile, duration) by EOD Thursday.

leo: Confirmed. Will create alert definitions and runbooks; will include mitigation steps for both automated and manual paths.

olivia: Confirmed. I'll publish a draft docs PR and link it here. ETA: Thursday midday.

product-bot: Friendly reminder — add these owners & checks to the GA checklist doc: https://redwood.work/docs/ga-checklist (see section "Launch safety nets").

maya: Action items with rough deadlines:
- sam: legal/SLA exceptions — Thu EOD
- nina: canary ticket + checklist (RH-5021) — Thu EOD
- eng-oncall: smoke test + script — Wed EOD
- leo: alert defs + rollback runbook — Thu midday
- olivia: docs + pricing draft — Thu midday
- finops: pricing numbers (please chime in) — Thu EOD

sam: I'll get finance looped in now. @finops please advise on suggested commit discount thresholds.

maya: Risk flags to call out in GA doc (we'll put these under "Known risks"): possible infra cost spike if enterprise customers require 99.95%; observability gaps for quantized fallbacks; edge-case latency regressions during cold starts.

nina: Also: dependency on Dedicated autoscale config — if autoscale lag > 30s the canary target won't meet SLA. Ops to validate scaling policy.

eng-oncall: Noted. I'll include scaling latency checks in the canary checklist.

olivia: I'll add a small "what to expect" section in user-facing docs about transient latency and availability targets.

maya: Final ask — please update the GA checklist doc with the owner matrix and ping me when done. If anyone can't meet deadlines, flag ASAP. :thumbsup:

sam: Pinged legal + finance. Will update thread with any constraints.

leo: Adding a short decision table to the GA doc for SLA / pricing tradeoffs (will link).

maya: Thanks all — looks like we have a path. We'll reconvene Friday 10am PT if anything outstanding.

olivia: :raised_hands:

product-bot: Thread summary saved to GA checklist.

maya: Closing thread for now — will re-open if blockers pop up.
